inspection.style: Exact silver spiky hair, tilted silver/navy headband, one visible eye and navy mask, olive pocket vest, navy outfit/red sleeve spiral, white straps/anklewraps, open-toe sandals and ivory shoulder roll. Current card etched hatching/stipple and magenta/cyan edge accent.
warnings: Actor-only sheets deliberately omit foreground photocopier; action poses4/5 place the extended hand at implied waist-high machine control position. Composite machine separately.
Shoulder scroll remains attached in every pose, matching existing CC013 actors. No long ribbons or clone are baked in.
Ending contains hand-held small instruction paper connected to actor; paper has crude triangle marks only, no text.
Instruction pictograms do not clearly communicate upside-down orientation. Overlay a reversed copyright mark or instruction cue separately if that joke is needed.
Ending pose2 includes tiny detached surprise ink ticks; large-component extraction should discard these.
Extract connected components rather than equal cells. Hair/toes cross nominal row boundaries but eight silhouettes remain separate.
inspection.background: Empty office-dojo with wide tatami foreground, distant copier at right, filing furniture, blank noticeboard and neon lights. No character or moving paper.

summary: 16 intact full-body actor cutouts and one fixed empty photocopy dojo. Foreground copier, clones, moving paper and watermarks remain separate for continuous compositing.
